The '''Relgim Run''', also known as the '''Relgim hyperspace lane''',<ref name="Riders of the Maelstrom">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Run was frequently used by the luxury [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']], on its voyages between [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]] and [[Endoraan]].

==Astrography==
The route, which originated near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fedje]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]], a planet that was located along the neighboring [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]], another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|lane]] that was situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], stretched to the planets [[Fest/Legends|Fest]] and [[Generis/Legends|Generis]], which were also located within the Atrivis [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and then spanned out to the planet [[Vykos]] and the [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|Maelstrom Nebula]] in the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]]. It later ran through the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]], which neighbored the Relgim sector, and stretched past the sector's worlds of [[Aris/Legends|Aris]]&mdash;another planet situated along the Braxant Run&mdash;and [[Marmoth]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Relgim Run first appeared in [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']], a supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Ray Winninger]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1989]], albeit first identified as the Relgim hyperspace lane.<ref name="Riders of the Maelstrom" /> It later appeared in the short story "[[A Certain Point of View (short story)|A Certain Point of View]]," which was written by [[Charlene Newcomb]] and published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]] by West End Games in [[1995]], where the name Relgim Run was first used.<ref name="SWAJ" />
